title: neural-trees: soft decision trees, hierarchical mixtures of experts and classifier comparison tests for Python
description:
A scikit-learn compatible library of differentiable and constructive classifiers with a PyTorch backend: soft decision trees, multivariate and omnivariate trees, hierarchical mixtures of experts, a grow-and-prune network, condensed nearest neighbour with voting, and the statistical tests used to decide whether one classifier is genuinely better than another.

The implementations start from published algorithms and depart from them where measurement justified it; each deviation is documented in the module docstring with the numbers behind it.
